1.1: Ad ematay chorshin bisde hailan erev sheviit. bet shammay omrim, kol zeman shehu yafe lapperi. uvet hillel omrim, ad haatzeret. ukerovin divre ellu lihyot kedivre ellu:
1.2: Ezehu sede hailan, kol shelosha ilanot levet sea, im reuyin laasot kikkar devela shel shishshim mane baitalki, chorshim kol bet sea bishvilan. pachot mikkan, en chorshin lahen ella melo haore vesallo chutza lo:
1.3: Echad ilan serak veechad ilan maachol, roin otan keillu hem teenim. im reuyim laasot kikkar devela shel shishshim mane baitalki, chorshim kol bet sea bishvilan. pachot mikkan, en chorshim lahem ella letzarkan:
1.4: Haya echad ose kikkar devela ushenayim en osin, o shenayim osin veechad eno ose, en chorshin lahem ella letzarkan, ad sheyyihyu mishshelosha vead tisha. hayu asara, measara ulemala, ben osin ben sheenan osin, chorshin kol bet sea bishvilan. shenneemar (Shemot led) becharish uvakkatzir tishbot, en tzarich lomar charish vekatzir shel sheviit, ella charish shel erev sheviit shehu nichnas bashsheviit, vekatzir shel sheviit shehu yotze lemotzae sheviit. rabbi yishmael omer, ma charish reshut, af katzir reshut, yatza ketzir haomer:
1.5: Shelosha ilanot shel shelosha anashim, hare ellu mitztarfin, vechorshin kol bet sea bishvilan. vechamma yehe venehem, rabban gamliel omer, kede sheyyehe habbakar over bechelav:
1.6: Eser netiot mefuzzarot betoch bet sea, chorshin kol bet sea bishvilan, ad rosh hashshana. hayu asuyot shura umukkafot atara, en chorshin lahem ella letzarkan:
1.7: Hannetiot vehaddeluim, mitztarfin letoch bet sea. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, kol asara deluim levet sea, chorshin kol bet sea ad rosh hashshana:
1.8: Ad ematay nikreu netiot. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer, ad sheyyachollu. rabbi yehoshua omer, bat sheva shanim. rabbi akiva omer, netia chishmah. ilan shennigmam vehotzi chalifin, mittefach ulematta kintia, mittefach ulemala, keilan, divre rabbi shimon:

2.1: Ad ematay chorshin bisde hallavan erev sheviit. ad shettichle hallecha, kol zeman shebbene adam chorshim litta bammikshaot uvammidlaot. amar rabbi shimon, natatta torat kol echad veechad beyado, ella bisde hallavan ad happesach, uvisde hailan ad atzeret:
2.2: Mezabbelin umeadderin bammikshaot uvammidlaot ad rosh hashshana. vechen bevet hashshelachin. meyabbelin, mefarkin, meabbekin, meashshenin, ad rosh hashshana. rabbi shimon omer, af notel hu et heale min haeshkol bashsheviit:
2.3: Mesakkelin ad rosh hashshana. mekarsemin, mezardin, mefasselin, ad rosh hashshana. rabbi yehoshua omer, kezerudah uchefissulah shel chamishshit, kach shel shishshit. rabbi shimon omer, kol zeman sheani rashshay baavodat hailan, rashshay ani befissulo:
2.4: Mezahamin et hannetiot, vechorchin otan, vekotmin otan, veosin lahen battim, umashkin otan, ad rosh hashshana. rabbi elazar bar tzadok omer, af mashke hu et hannof bashsheviit, aval lo et haikkar:
2.5: Sachin et happaggim umenakkevim otam, ad rosh hashshana. pagge erev sheviit shennichnesu lashsheviit, veshel sheviit sheyyatzu lemotzae sheviit, lo sachin velo menakkevin otan. rabbi yehuda omer, mekom shennahagu lasuch, enan sachin, mippene shehi avoda. mekom shennahagu shello lasuch, sachin. rabbi shimon mattir bailan, mippene shehu rashshay baavodat hailan:
2.6: En notin veen mavrichin veen markivin erev sheviit pachot mishsheloshim yom lifne rosh hashshana. veim nata o hivrich o hirkiv, yaakor. rabbi yehuda omer, kol harekava sheenah koletet lishlosha yamim, shuv enah koletet. rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim, lishte shabbatot:
2.7: Haorez vehaddochan vehapperagin vehashshumshemin shehishrishu lifne rosh hashshana, mitasserin lesheavar, umuttarin bashsheviit. veim lav, asurin bashsheviit, umitasserin leshana habbaa:
2.8: Rabbi shimon shezuri omer, pol hammitzri shezzerao lezera battechilla, kayyotze vahen. rabbi shimon omer, afunin haggamlonin, kayyotze vahen. rabbi elazar omer, afunin haggamlonin, mishshettirmelu lifne rosh hashshana:
2.9: Habbetzalim hassarisim, ufol hammitzri, shemmana mehem mayim sheloshim yom lifne rosh hashshana, mitasserin lesheavar, umuttarim bashsheviit, veim lav, asurim bashsheviit, umitasserin leshana habbaa. veshel baal shemmana mehem mayim shete onot, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, shalosh:
2.10: Haddeluin shekkiyyeman lezera, im hikshu lifne rosh hashshana venifselu meochel adam, muttar lekayyeman bashsheviit. veim lav, asur lekayyeman bashsheviit. hattemarot shellahem, asurot bashsheviit. umarbitzin beafar lavan, divre rabbi shimon, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov oser. memarsin baorez bashsheviit, rabbi shimon omer, aval en mechassechin:

3.1: Meematay motziin zevalim leashfattot. mishsheyyifseku ovde avoda, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, mishsheyyivash hammatok. rabbi yose omer, mishsheyyikshor:
3.2: Ad kamma mezabbelin, ad shalosh shalosh ashpattot levet sea shel eser eser mashpelot shel letech letech. mosifin al hammashpelot, veen mosifin al haashpattot. rabbi shimon omer, af al haashpattot:
3.3: Ose adam et sadehu shalosh shalosh ashpattot levet sea. yater mikkan, machatziv, divre rabbi shimon. vachachamim osrin, ad sheyyaamik shelosha, o ad sheyyagbiah shelosha. ose adam et zivlo otzar. rabbi meir oser, ad sheyyaamik shelosha, o ad sheyyagbiah shelosha. haya lo davar muat, mosif alav veholech. rabbi elazar ben azarya oser, ad sheyyaamik shelosha, o ad sheyyagbiah shelosha, o ad sheyyitten al hassala:
3.4: Hamedayyer et sadehu, ose sahar levet satayim, oker shalosh ruchot umanniach et haemtzait. nimtza medayyer bet arbaat sein. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, bet shemonat sein. hayta chol sadehu bet arbaat sein, meshayyer mimmenna miktzat, mippene marit haayin, umotzi min hassahar venoten letoch sadehu kederech hamezabbelin:
3.5: Lo yiftach adam machtzev battechilla letoch sadehu, ad sheyyihyu vo shalosh murebiyyot, shehem shalosh al shalosh al rum shalosh, shiuran esrim vesheva avanim:
3.6: Gader sheyyesh bo eser avanim shel masseoy shenayim shenayim, hare ellu yinnatelu. shiur gader, asara tefachim. pachot mikkan, mechatztzev vegommo ad pachot mehaaretz tefach. bamme devarim amurim, mittoch shello, aval mittoch shel chavero, ma shehu rotze, yittol. bamme devarim amurim, bizman shelo hitchil bo meerev sheviit. aval im hitchil bo meerev sheviit, ma shehu rotze, notel:
3.7: Avanim shezzizeatan hammacharesha, o shehayu mechussot venitgallu, im yesh bahem shetayim shel masseoy shenayim shenayim, hare ellu yinnatelu. hamesakkel et sadehu, notel et haelyonot, umanniach et hannogot baaretz. vechen garger shel tzerorot o gal shel avanim, notel et haelyonot, umanniach et hannogot baaretz. im yesh tachtehen sela o kash, hare ellu yinnatelu:
3.8: En bonin madregot al pi haggeayot erev sheviit mishsheppasku haggeshamim, mippene shehu metakkenan lashsheviit. aval bone hu bashsheviit mishsheppasku geshamim, mippene shehu metakkenan lemotzae sheviit. velo yismoch beafar, aval ose hu chayitz. kol even shehu yachol lifshot et yado velittelah, hare zo tinnatel:
3.9: Avne chatef, baot mikkol makom. vehakkabbelan, mevi mikkol makom. veellu hem avne chatef, kol sheenah yechola lehinnatel beachat yad, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer, avne chatef kishman, kol shehen nittalot shetayim shalosh al hakkatef:
3.10: Habbone gader beno uven reshut harabbim, muttar lehaamik ad hassela. ma yaase beafar, tzovro birshut harabbim umetakkeno, divre rabbi yehoshua. rabbi akiva omer, kederech sheen mekalkelin birshut harabbim, kach lo yetakkenu. ma yaase beafar, tzovro betoch sadehu kederech hamezabbelin. vechen hachofer bor veshiach umeara:

4.1: Barishona hayu omrim, melakket adam etzim vaavanim vaasavim mittoch shello, kederech shehu melakket mittoch shel chavero, et haggas haggas. mishsherabbu ovre avera, hitkinu sheyyehe ze melakket mittoch shel ze, veze melakket mittoch shel ze, shello vetova, veen tzarich lomar sheyyekatztzetz lahem mezonot:
4.2: Sade shennitkavvetza, tizzara bemotzae sheviit. shennittayyeva o shenniddayyera, lo tizzara bemotzae sheviit. sade shennittayyeva, bet shammay omrim, en ochlin peroteha bashsheviit, uvet hillel omrim, ochlin. bet shammay omrim, en ochlin perot sheviit betova, uvet hillel omrim, ochlin betova veshello vetova. rabbi yehuda omer, chilluf haddevarim, zo mikkulle vet shammay umechumre vet hillel:
4.3: Chochrin nirin min hannachrim bashsheviit, aval lo miyyisrael. umachazikin yede nachrim bashsheviit, aval lo yede yisrael. veshoalin bishloman, mippene darche shalom:
4.4: Hammedel bazzetim, bet shammay omrim, yagom. uvet hillel omrim, yesharesh. umodim bemachalik, ad sheyyagom. eze hu hammedel, echad o shenayim. hammachalik, shelosha, ze vetzad ze. bamme devarim amurim, mittoch shello, aval mittoch shel chavero, af hammachalik, yesharesh:
4.5: Hammavkia bazzayit, lo yechappehu veafar, aval mechasse hu baavanim o vekash. hakkotzetz korot shikma, lo yechappehu veafar, aval mechasse hu baavanim o vekash. en kotztzin betulat shikma bashsheviit, mippene shehi avoda. rabbi yehuda omer, kedarkah, asur, ella o magbiah asara tefachim, o gomem meal haaretz:
4.6: Hamezannev bigfanim vehakkotzetz kanim, rabbi yose haggelili omer, yarchik tefach. rabbi akiva omer, kotzetz kedarko, bakkardom o vammaggal, uvammegera, uvechol ma sheyyirtze. ilan shennifshach, koshrin oto bashsheviit, lo sheyyaale, ella shello yosif:
4.7: Meematay ochlin perot hailan bashsheviit, happaggim mishsheyyazrichu, ochel bahem pitto bassade. bichalu, kones letoch beto. vechen kayyotze vahem bishar shene shavua, chayyav bammaasrot:
4.8: Habboser, mishshehevi mayim, ochel bo pitto bassade. hivish, kones letoch beto. vechen kayyotze vo bishar shene shavua, chayyav bemaasrot:
4.9: Zetim, mishsheyyachnisu reviit lisa, potzea veochel bassade. hichnisu chatzi log, kotesh vesach bassade. hichnisu shelish, kotesh bassade vechones letoch beto. vechen kayyotze vahem bishar shene shavua, chayyavim bemaasrot. ushear kol perot hailan, keonatan lammaasrot, ken onatan lashsheviit:
4.10: Meematay en kotztzin et hailan bashsheviit. bet shammay omrim, kol hailan mishsheyyotzi. uvet hillel omrim, hecharuvin mishsheyyeshalshelu, vehaggefanim mishsheyyegaru, vehazzetim mishsheyyanetzu, ushear kol ilan mishsheyyotzi. vechol hailan, kevan shebba leonat hammaasrot, muttar lekatztzo. kamma yehe vazzayit velo yekutztzennu, rova. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, hakkol lefi hazzayit:

5.1: Benot shuach, sheviit shellahen, sheniyya, shehen osot leshalosh shanim. rabbi yehuda omer, happarsaot, sheviit shellahen, motzae sheviit, shehen osot lishte shanim. amru lo, lo amru ella venot shuach:
5.2: Hattomen et halluf bashsheviit, rabbi meir omer, lo yifchot missatayim, ad gova shelosha tefachim, vetefach afar al gabbav. vachachamim omrim, lo yifchot mearbaat kabbim, ad gova tefach, vetefach afar al gabbav. vetomno vimkom derisat adam:
5.3: Luf sheavra alav sheviit, rabbi eliezer omer, im laktu haaniyyim et alav, lakatu. veim lav, yaase cheshbon im haaniyyim. rabbi yehoshua omer, im laktu haaniyyim et alav, lakatu. veim lav, en laaniyyim alav cheshbon:
5.4: Luf shel erev sheviit shenichnas lashsheviit, vechen betzalim hakketzonim, vechen pua shel iddit, bet shammay omrim, okrin otan bemaarufot shel etz. uvet hillel omrim, bekardummot shel mattachot. umodim befua shel tzelaot, sheokrin otah bekardummot shel mattachot:
5.5: Meematay muttar adam likkach luf bemotzae sheviit, rabbi yehuda omer, miyyad. vachachamim omrim, mishsheyyirbe hechadash:
5.6: Ellu chelim sheen haumman rashshay lemachram bashsheviit, macharesha vechol keleha, haol, vehammizre, vehaddakar. aval mocher hu maggal yad umaggal katzir, vaagala vechol keleha. ze hakkelal, kol shemmelachto meyuchedet laavera, asur. leissur ulehetter, muttar:
5.7: Hayyotzer, mocher chamishsha kadde shemen vachamishsha asar kadde yayin, shekken darko lehavi min hahefker. veim hevi yoter mikkan, muttar. umocher lenachrim baaretz, uleyyisrael bechutza laaretz:
5.8: Bet shammay omrim, lo yimkor lo fara choreshet bashsheviit. uvet hillel mattirin, mippene shehu yachol leshachatah. mocher lo perot afillu bishat hazzera, umashil lo seato af al pi shehu yodea sheyyesh lo goren, uforet lo maot af al pi shehu yodea sheyyesh lo poalim. vechullan, beferush, asurin:
5.9: Mashelet ishsha lachavertah hachashuda al hashsheviit nafa uchevara verechayim vetannur. aval lo tavor velo titchan immah. eshet chaver mashelet leeshet am haaretz nafa uchevara, uvoreret vetochenet umarkedet immah. aval mishshettattil hammayim, lo tigga etzlah, sheen machzikin yede ovre avera. vechullan lo amru ella mippene darche shalom. umachazikin yede nachrim bashsheviit, aval lo yede yisrael. veshoalin bishloman, mippene darche shalom:

6.1: Shalosh aratzot lashsheviit. kol shehecheziku ole vavel, meeretz yisrael vead keziv, lo neechol velo neevad. vechol shehecheziku ole mitzrayim, mikkeziv vead hannahar vead amana, neechol, aval lo neevad. min hannahar umeamana velifnim, neechol veneevad:
6.2: Osin betalush besureya, aval lo vimchubbar. dashim vezorin vedorchin umeammerin, aval lo kotzrin velo votzrin velo moskim. kelal amar rabbi akiva, kol shekkayyotze vo muttar beeretz yisrael, osin oto besureya:
6.3: Betzalim sheyyardu alehem geshamim vetzimmechu, im hayu healin shellahem shechorin, asurin. horiku, hare ellu muttarin. rabbi chanina ven antignos omer, im yecholin lehittalesh bealin shellahen, asurin. ucheneged ken, motzae sheviit, muttarin:
6.4: Meematay muttar adam likkach yarak bemotzae sheviit, mishsheyyaase chayyotze vo. asa habbakkir, huttar haafil. rabbi hittir likkach yarak bemotzae sheviit miyyad:
6.5: En motziin shemen serefa uferot sheviit mehaaretz lechutz laaretz. amar rabbi shimon, shamati veferush, shemmotziin lesureya veen motziin lechutz laaretz:
6.6: En meviin teruma mechutza laaretz laaretz. amar rabbi shimon, shamati beferush, shemmeviin missureya veen meviin michutza laaretz:

7.1: Kelal gadol amru bashsheviit, kol shehu maachal adam umaachal behema, umimmin hatztzovim, veeno mitkayyem baaretz, yesh lo sheviit uledamav sheviit, yesh lo biur uledamav biur. veeze ze, ale halluf hashshote, vaale haddandanna, haulshin, vehakkereshin, vehargila, venetz hechalav. umaachal behema, hachochim vehaddardarim. umimmin hatztzovim, sefiche istis, vekotza. yesh lahem sheviit velidmehen sheviit, yesh lahem biur velidmehen biur:
7.2: Veod kelal acher amru, kol sheeno maachal adam umaachal behema, umimmin hatztzovin, umitkayyem baaretz, yesh lo sheviit uledamav sheviit, en lo biur veen ledamav biur. e zehu, ikkar halluf hashshote, veikkar haddandanna, vehaarkavnin, vehachalbetzin, vehabbuchriyya. umimmin hatztzovin, happua veharichpa, yesh lahem sheviit velidmehen sheviit, en lahem biur velo lidmehen biur. rabbi meir omer, demehem mitbaarin ad rosh hashshana. amru lo, lahen en biur, kal vachomer lidmehen:
7.3: Kelippe rimmon vehannetz shello, kelippe egozim vehaggalinin, yesh lahem sheviit velidmehen sheviit. hatztzabba, tzovea leatzmo, velo yitzba besachar, sheen osin sechora beferot sheviit, velo vivchorot, velo vitrumot, velo vinvelot, velo vitrefot, velo vishkatzim, velo virmasim. velo yihye lokeach yarkot sade umocher bashshuk, aval hu loket uveno mocher al yado. lakach leatzmo vehotir, muttar lemachran:
7.4: Lakach bechor lemishte veno o laregel velo tzarich lo, muttar lemachro. tzade chayya ofot vedagim shennizdammenu lahem minim temein, muttarim lemachran. rabbi yehuda omer, af mi shennitmanna lo lefi darko, lokeach umocher, uvilvad shello tehe ummanuto vechach. vachachamim osrin:
7.5: Luleve zeradim vehecharuvin, yesh lahem sheviit velidmehen sheviit, yesh lahen biur velidmehen biur. luleve haela vehabbatna vehaatadin, yesh lahem sheviit, velidmehen sheviit, en lahem biur velo lidmehen biur. aval lealin yesh biur, mippene shennoshrin meavihen:
7.6: Havvered vehakkofer vehakketaf vehallotem, yesh lahem sheviit velidmehen sheviit. rabbi shimon omer, en lakketaf sheviit, mippene sheeno feri:
7.7: Vered chadash shekkevasho beshemen yashan, yelakket et havvered. veyashan bechadash, chayyav babbiur. charuvin chadashim shekkevashan beyayin yashan, vishanim bechadash, chayyavin babbiur. ze hakkelal, kol shehu venoten taam, chayyav levaer, min besheeno mino. umin bemino, kol shehu. sheviit oseret kol shehu beminah, veshello veminah, benoten taam:

8.1: Kelal gadol amru bashsheviit, kol hameyuchad lemaachal adam, en osin mimmennu melugema laadam, veen tzarich lomar labbehema. vechol sheeno meyuchad lemaachal adam, osin mimmennu melugema leadam, aval lo livhema. vechol sheeno meyuchad lo lemaachal adam velo lemaachal behema, chashav alav lemaachal adam ulemaachal behema, notnin alav chumre adam vechumre vehema. chashav alav leetzim, hare hu cheetzim, kegon hassia vehaezov vehakkoranit:
8.2: Sheviit, nittena laachila velishtiyya ulesicha, leechol davar sheddarko leechol, velasuch davar sheddarko lasuch. lo yasuch yayin vachometz, aval sach hu et hashshamen. vechen bitruma uvemaaser sheni. kal mehem sheviit, shennittena lehadelakat hanner:
8.3: En mochrin perot sheviit, lo vemidda, velo vemishkal, velo veminyan, velo teenim beminyan, velo yarak bemishkal. bet shammay omrim, af lo aguddot. uvet hillel omrim, et sheddarko leegod babbayit, ogdin oto bashshuk, kegon hakkereshin venetz hechalav:
8.4: Haomer lappoel, he lach issar ze ulekot li yarak hayyom, secharo muttar. lekot li bo yarak hayyom, secharo asur. lakach min hannachtom kikkar befunedyon, kesheelkot yarkot sade avi lach, muttar. lakach mimmennu setam, lo yeshallem lo middeme sheviit, sheen porin chov middeme sheviit:
8.5: En notnim, lo levayyar, velo levallan, velo lesappar, velo lesappan. aval noten hu levayyar lishtot. ulechullan, hu noten mattenat chinnam:
8.6: Teenim shel sheviit, en kotzin otan bemuktze, aval kotze otam bacharba. en dorchin anavim baggat, aval dorech hu baareva. veen osin zetim babbad uvakkotev, aval kotesh hu umachnis labbodida. rabbi shimon omer, af tochen hu bevet habbad umachnis labbodida:
8.7: En mevashshelin yarak shel sheviit beshemen shel teruma, shello yeviennu lide fesul. rabbi shimon mattir. veacharon acharon, nitpas bashsheviit. vehapperi atzmo, asur:
8.8: En lokchim avadim vekarkaot uvehema temea middeme sheviit. veim lakach, yochal kenegdan. en meviin kinne zavim vekinne zavot vekinne yoldot middeme sheviit. veim hevi, yochal kenegdan. en sachin kelim beshemen shel sheviit. veim sach, yochal kenegdo:
8.9: Or shessacho beshemen shel sheviit, rabbi eliezer omer, yiddalek. vachachamim omrim, yochal kenegdo. amru lifne rabbi akiva, omer haya rabbi eliezer, or shessacho veshemen shel sheviit, yiddalek. amar lahem, shetoku, lo omar lachem ma sherabbi eliezer omer bo:
8.10: Veod amru lefanav, omer haya rabbi eliezer, haochel pat kutim keochel besar chazir. amar lahem, shetoku, lo omar lachem ma sherabbi eliezer omer bo:
8.11: Merchatz shehusseka beteven o vekash shel sheviit, muttar lirchotz bah. veim mitchashshev hu, hare ze lo yirchotz:

9.1: Happegam, vehayyarbuzin hashshotim, vehachalaglogit, kusbar shebbeharim, vehakkarpas shebbanneharot, vehaggarger shel afar, peturin min hammaasrot, venilkachin mikkol adam bashsheviit, sheen kayyotze vahem nishmar. rabbi yehuda omer, sefiche chardal, muttarin, shello nechshedu alehen ovre avera. rabbi shimon omer, kol hassefichin muttarin, chutz missefiche cheruv, sheen kayyotze vahem beyarkot sade. vachachamim omrim, kol hassefichin asurin:
9.2: Shalosh aratzot labbiur, yehuda, veever hayyarden, vehaggalil. veshalosh shalosh aratzot lechol achat veachat. galil haelyon, vegalil hattachton, vehaemek. mikkefar chananya ulemalan, kol sheeno megaddel shikmin, galil haelyon, umikkefar chananya ulemattan, kol shehu megaddel shikmin, galil hattachton. utechum teverya, haemek. uvihuda, hahar vehashshefela vehaemek. ushefelat lod kishfelat haddarom, vehahar shellah kehar hammelech. mibbet choron vead hayyam medina echat:
9.3: Velamma amru shalosh aratzot, sheyyihyu ochlin bechol achat veachat ad sheyyichle haacharon shebbah. rabbi shimon omer, lo amru shalosh aratzot ella vihuda. ushear kol haaratzot, kehar hammelech. vechol haaratzot, keachat lazzetim velattemarim:
9.4: Ochlin al hammufkar, aval lo al hashshamur. rabbi yose mattir af al hashshamur. ochlin al hattefichin veal haddufera, aval lo al hassitvaniyyot. rabbi yehuda mattir kol zeman shebbikkeru ad shello yichle hakkayitz:
9.5: Hakkovesh shelosha chevashim bechavit achat, rabbi eliezer omer, ochlin al harishon. rabbi yehoshua omer, af al haacharon. rabban gamliel omer, kol shekkala mino min hassade, yevaer mino min hechavit, vahalacha chidvarav. rabbi shimon omer, kol yarak, echad labbiur. ochlin bargila ad sheyyichlu siggariyyot mibbikat bet netofa:
9.6: Hamelakket asavim lachim, ad sheyyivash hammatok. vehamegabbev bayyavesh, ad shettered revia sheniyya. ale kanim vaale gefanim, ad sheyyishsheru meavihen. vehamegabbev bayyavesh, ad shettered revia sheniyya. rabbi akiva omer, bechullan ad shettered revia sheniyya:
9.7: Kayyotze vo, hammaskir bayit lachavero ad haggeshamim, ad shettered revia sheniyya. hammuddar hanaa mechavero ad haggeshamim, ad shettered revia sheniyya. ad ematay aniyyim nichnasim lappardesot, ad shettered revia sheniyya. meematay nehenin vesorfin batteven uvakkash shel sheviit, mishettered revia sheniyya:
9.8: Mi shehayu lo perot sheviit vehiggia sheat habbiur, mechallek mezon shalosh seuddot lechol echad veechad. vaaniyyim ochlin achar habbiur, aval lo ashirim, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer, echad aniyyim veechad ashirim ochlin achar habbiur:
9.9: Mi shehayu lo perot sheviit shennaflu lo virushsha o shennittenu lo bemattana, rabbi eliezer omer, yinnatnu leochlehen. vachachamim omrim, en hachote niskar, ella yimmachru leochlehen, udemehem yitchalleku lechol adam. haochel meissat sheviit ad shello hurema challatah, chayyav mita:

10.1: Sheviit, meshammetet et hammilva bishtar veshello vishtar. hakkafat hachanut, enah meshammetet, veim asaah milva, hare ze meshammet. rabbi yehuda omer, harishon harishon meshammet. sechar sachir, eno meshammet, veim asao milva, hare ze meshammet. rabbi yose omer, kol melacha shepposeket bashsheviit, meshammetet, vesheenah poseket bashsheviit, enah meshammetet:
10.2: Hashshochet et happara vechillekah berosh hashshana, im haya hachodesh meubbar, meshammet. veim lav, eno meshammet. haones, vehamefatte, vehammotzi shem ra, vechol maase vet din, en meshammetin. hammalve al hammashkon, vehammoser shetarotav levet din, enan meshammetin:
10.3: Perozbul, eno meshammet. ze echad min haddevarim shehitkin hillel hazzaken, kesheraa shennimneu haam millehalvot ze et ze veovrin al ma shekkatuv battora (Devarim 15) hishshamer lecha pen yihye davar im levavcha beliyyaal vegomer, hitkin hillel lapperozbul:
10.4: Zehu gufo shel perozbul. moser ani lachem ish peloni ufeloni haddayyanim shebbemakom peloni, shekkol chov sheyyesh li, sheegbennu kol zeman sheertze. vehaddayyanim chotmin lematta, o haedim:
10.5: Perozbul hammukdam, kasher, vehameuchar, pasul. shitre chov hammukdamim, pesulim, vehameucharim, kesherim. echad love mechamishsha, kotev perozbul lechol echad veechad. chamishsha lovin meechad, eno chotev ella perozbul echad lechullam:
10.6: En kotvin perozbul ella al hakkarka. im en lo, mezakke hu betoch sadehu kol shehu. hayta lo sade memushkenet bair, kotvin aleha perozbul. rabbi chutzpit omer, kotvin laish al nichse ishto, velaytomim al nichse appotroppin:
10.7: Kavveret devorim, rabbi eliezer omer, hare hi chekarka, vechotvin aleha perozbul, veenah mekabbelet tuma bimkomah, veharode mimmenna beshabbat chayyav. vachachamim omrim, enah kekarka, veen kotvin aleha perozbul, umekabbelet tuma bimkomah, veharode mimmenna beshabbat, patur:
10.8: Hammachazir chov bashsheviit, yomar lo meshammet ani. amar lo af al pi chen, yekabbel mimmennu, shenneemar (Devarim 15) veze devar hashshemitta. kayyotze vo, rotzeach sheggala leir miklat veratzu anshe hair lechabbedo, yomar lahem, rotzeach ani. amru lo, af al pi chen, yekabbel mehem, shenneemar (sham 19) veze devar harotzeach:
10.9: Hammachazir chov bashsheviit, ruach chachamim nocha mimmennu. hallove min hagger shennitgayyeru vanav immo, lo yachazir levanav. veim hechezir, ruach chachamim nocha mimmennu. kol hammittaltelin, niknin bimshicha. vechol hamekayyem et devaro, ruach chachamim nocha mimmennu:
